newsitem.title: USA: Theratx says no change in Medicaid payouts.
newsitem.headline: Theratx says no change in Medicaid payouts.

text.p: Theratx said Tuesday it has not experienced any material change in Medicaid reimbursement.

John Bardis, president and chief executive, said, "Our record results for the quarter and the nine-month period reflect the success of our strategy to provide outcomes-focused care in our core postacute business and the evolution of our occupational health care operations."

Responding to recent questions regarding changes in Medicare reimbursement practices, Bardis said, "In its recent dealings with Medicare fiscal intermediaries, the Company has not experienced any material change in Medicare reimbursement."
"Accordingly, our accounting policies and practices reflect our continuing experience with Medicare reimbursement."

Earlier, the company reported Net income of $6.1 million, or $0.29 per share, in the third quarter, an increase of 19 percent over earnings for the quarter ended Sept. 30, 1995 of $5.1 million, or $0.25 per share.
Net revenues for the quarter ended Sept. 30, 1996 totaled $99.4 million, an increase of 18 percent over the $84.6 million reported for the quarter ended Sept. 30, 1995.

For the nine months ended Sept. 30, 1996, net income was $17.2 million, or $0.82 per share, an increase of 48 percent over earnings for the nine months ended Sept. 30, 1995 of $11.6 million, or $0.57 per share, before merger-related costs and the extraordinary item in the 1995 period. Net revenues for the nine months ended Sept. 30, 1996 totaled $288.6 million, an increase of 28 percent over the $225.6 million reported for the nine months ended Sept. 30, 1995.
